release_notes: Orbitra 2.1.3: Reports now live inside Analytics as the first sub-tab (Reports | Trends | Cohorts), freeing up space in the main navigation bar so full labels fit comfortably on 15" screens; saved ?tab=reports links redirect automatically, and Trends no longer fetches in the background when viewing Reports or Cohorts. AI Assistant & MCP: safe generation, copying and static file editing for local landings and local offers (HTML/CSS/JS/SVG/JSON only, PHP always blocked, active campaigns protected from live overwrites, with an isolated HTML preview inside the confirmation card), plus admin-only CRM (Anti-Shaving Vault) tools and LeadForge guidance. UI polish: removed the duplicate "+" prefix from the CRM "New Lead" button across all locales. No migrations and no new cron lines.
